name: Fragments of Rok'Alim
summary: Across Thousand Needles, Rok'Alim's stone fragments bear witness to a warrior's victory. Dorn Plainstalker at the Weathered Nook seeks them as proof Rok'Alim fell in single combat.

sections.title: Remnants of an Ancient Power
sections.body: Rok'Alim the Pounder still walks the canyon flats south of the main thoroughfare. Most elementals faded from Azeroth after the Old Gods were banished, though a few powerful ones endured without mortal summoning. The local centaur know Rok'Alim by the crashes of his stone fists as they crush anything in his path. Defeat leaves jagged pieces of dense, animated rock, proof of a warrior's might.

sections.title: The Trial of Might
sections.body: Dorn Plainstalker needs the fragments for the Test of Strength. The tauren hermit holds spiritual and martial rites high in the Weathered Nook. An initiate must face a being of unyielding brute force. Bringing Dorn the battered pieces of Rok'Alim proves the bravery and might needed to survive Kalimdor's harshest perils.

faq.q: What are the Fragments of Rok'Alim?
faq.answer: The Fragments of Rok'Alim are broken pieces of Rok'Alim the Pounder, an ancient earth elemental who prowls Thousand Needles' northwestern canyons. They prove he was defeated.
Dorn Plainstalker wants the stone fragments for the Test of Strength. The tauren hermit lives at the Weathered Nook high along Thousand Needles' canyon cliffs.

Rok'Alim has endured since the era of the Old Gods, though most elementals faded after their banishment unless mortals summoned them. Centaur tribes in the canyons know him as the Pounder for the crashes of his fists as they crush prey.
Rok'Alim roams Thousand Needles' northwestern basin, south of the region's main road among the sandstone spires.

angles.text: As a tauren, facing the land's most formidable hazards tests your harmony, fortitude, and strength against remnants of Azeroth's primordial past.
As a shaman, you can study Rok'Alim's unyielding nature as an example of elemental tenacity. He is an ancient earth spirit bound to the world before modern shamanic pacts.
